gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-noto-sans-yi: Noto Sans Yi reads modern and businesslike, with deep lowercase bodies and rounds left open. Delius Unicase brings a loose, hand-drawn warmth above it, so a long run of the sans-serif text feels friendly without losing its footing.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-noto-sans-zanab: Loose and handwritten, Delius Unicase draws each stroke at a single width with a generous lowercase. And Noto Sans Zanabazar Square carries on in a plain sans, its soaring x-height and wide gaps making paragraphs feel open and easy going.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-noto-traditiona: Delius Unicase looks like one thick thread traced slowly through every letter, with no tapering anywhere. Noto Traditional Nushu follows with broad-pen bowls, so paragraphs feel unhurried.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-numans: Numans reads modern and spaced out, its lowercase swollen and its s ends hanging far from the spine. Delius Unicase supplies the warmth.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-onest: Onest keeps its ascenders short above big bowls, with a gentle sameness of line. Delius Unicase is best at relaxed, rod-like friendliness; Onest is best at quiet, approachable text in a sans that never fusses.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-open-sans: Delius Unicase writes in rods of one constant width. Open Sans sits beside it with smooth, bulky lowercase and no clogged curves, so the two feel like a friendly chat between loose handwriting and tidy modern type.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-orienta: Orienta reads modern and cool, its counters breathing open like a hollow reed and its cases close in height. Delius Unicase is best at stitched, thread-like friendliness; Orienta is best at tidy, quiet text.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-oxygen: Delius Unicase squeezes its strokes out like one steady line of toothpaste. Oxygen's open curves and capital-sized lowercase can run at a slightly larger size than you might expect, keeping a plain sans body roomy.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-parkinsans: Parkinsans reads crisp and modern, one stroke thickness throughout, with wide-mouthed letters that survive shrinking. Delius Unicase is best at relaxed, hand-drawn welcome; Parkinsans is best at steady, tidy text.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-pathway-extreme: Delius Unicase glows like neon tubing, one steady line throughout. Pathway Extreme follows in a sans with open rounds and stubby ascenders beside a big x-height, so long paragraphs feel compact and clean.
